
Admin resources
===============

+----------+-----------------+-------+----------------------------------------------+----------+
| Resource | URL             | Table | Permissions                                  | Class    |
+----------+-----------------+-------+----------------------------------------------+----------+
| Users    | /admin/accounts | users | users.manage (+create, update, delete)       | built in |
| Media    | /admin/media    | media | content.media.view (+create, update, delete) | built in |
+----------+-----------------+-------+----------------------------------------------+----------+

Settings pages
--------------
+-------------+----------------------------+---------+--------+----------------+
| Page        | URL                        | Keys    | Fields | Permission     |
+-------------+----------------------------+---------+--------+----------------+
| Admin panel | /admin/settings/edit/panel | panel.* | 7      | settings.panel |
+-------------+----------------------------+---------+--------+----------------+

Dashboard widgets
-----------------
! None: the dashboard shows resource counts. Create one with php flo make:admin-widget Overview

Panel pages
-----------
! None: php flo make:admin-page SalesReport --view --table
